parameters.query: SELECT c.id AS conversation_id, c.contact_id, c.last_message_at, c.status, ct.display_name, ct.phone, ct.email, (SELECT text_body FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = c.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_text FROM conversations c JOIN contacts ct ON c.contact_id = ct.id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.last_message_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days' AND c.last_message_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '4 days' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.created_at > c.last_message_at AND m.sender_type = 'staff' AND m.metadata->>'recovery_attempt' = 'true') ORDER BY c.last_message_at ASC LIMIT 10;
INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender_type, message_type, text_body, metadata, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'outgoing', 'staff', 'text', $2, $3, NOW(), NOW());

INSERT INTO audit_logs (entity_type, entity_id, action, performed_by, performed_by_type, description, new_values, metadata) VALUES ('conversation', $1::uuid, 'recovery_attempt', 'system', 'automation', $2, jsonb_build_object('recovery_attempt', true), jsonb_build_object('contact_id', $3::uuid, 'timestamp', NOW())) RETURNING id;
